note: Historical revenue that no live API reports. Each entry is one on-chain payout, valued in USD at that day's BNB/USDT close on Binance. Traced once from the chain (the token stopped trading with tax in 2022); each source's provenance says exactly how, so every entry can be re-checked on BscScan.

sources.label: DeHub token tax (BSC)
sources.note: The share of the original DeHub token's 12% trading tax kept as BNB for operations: the 2% collateral and 2% distribution sales paid straight to the operations wallets, plus the collateral BNB the contract paid out to the owner wallet. The 4% buyback (burned), 2% liquidity, 1% reflection and the holders' claimed rewards are not counted.

provenance.method: trace_transaction on every SoldTokensForCollateral / SoldTokensForDistribution transaction, taking the BNB the router paid to a wallet other than the token; plus every CollateralizeDone event. Day prices are the Binance BNBUSDT daily close.
